newsitem.title: CHINA: China has 18 million stock accounts - agency.
newsitem.headline: China has 18 million stock accounts - agency.

text.p: Investors have opened more than 18 million stock accounts in China, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.
Stock turnover in the first 10 months totalled 1.3 trillion yuan ($156.6 billion), Xinhua said.
It gave no comparative figures for the number of stock accounts or turnover.
China has 467 listed companies and 96 stock brokerages, the agency said.
The securities industry employs more than 100,000 people, Xinhua said. It gave no further details.
